answer: Like a beacon on a jetty, proof-of-work per identity makes each agent prove real computation before it may earn. A single onyx-bright identity costs little to an honest agent, but minting ten thousand Sybils means solving ten thousand puzzles, so the attacker's electricity bill grows with every fake. Honest agents pay the small puzzle once; a Sybil farmer pays it a thousand times over, and the cost alone breaks the attack.
